MT FLAP BLACKF 12(1) FLAP Rehabilitation Two Medicine Road / MT NP GLAC 12(2) FLTP Rehabilitation of Two Medicine Road

The work consists of reconstruction of asphalt pavement roadway, replacement of existing culverts, and mill and overlay of two parking areas and other small items of work.

Project length:  7.22 miles

Tentative Fixed Completion Date:  Fall 2027

(Once solicitation is issued, see FAR Clause 52.211-10 for exact date.)

Estimated Price Range:  $15,000,000 and $25,000,000

Project Location:   This project is located approximately 4 Miles NW of East Glacier, MT

See Attachments for additional information.
